containers.name: vllm
args: set --; if [ "${AGENT_INFERENCE_TRACING_ENABLED:-true}" = "true" ]; then set -- --otlp-traces-endpoint "$OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT" --collect-detailed-traces all; fi; exec python3 -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server --model "$INFERENCE_MODEL_PATH" --served-model-name "$INFERENCE_MODEL_NAME" --port 8000 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 --swap-space "$VLLM_CPU_SWAP_SPACE_GB" --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser hermes --enable-prefix-caching "$@"
